results.description: PACK RULE 13 - PROTECT YOUR TERRITORY I might be a happy-go-lucky Christmas tree farmer, but this holiday season, I’m all bah humbug. Blame the beautiful, infuriating Fairchild Hotel heiress, who’s swept into town to open a–gasp–luxury resort. A spa. A freaking yoga retreat on the land next to mine. No one in Cooper Valley hates the idea more than me. But no one needs her more than me because one whiff of her sweet scent, and I know she’s mine. My enemy. My fated mate. The more I fight with her, the more she gets under my skin. When the weather outside turns frightful, we’re stranded together in my cabin. There’s only one territory my wolf is interested in claiming this holiday. Her.
